title: Ragged per-graph Python loops and separate backward passes in a crystal GNN energy/force evaluator
authoring_note: SciML graph/materials positive anchor shaped after FAIRChem radius-graph + PBC energy/force evaluation. Baseline loops over graphs and calls backward once per graph; the reference fix concatenates the current ragged batch into a single batched graph and performs one batched backward. It does not reuse a graph across changing geometry. Plain torch only (no PyG); range reflects the measured 6.8x authoring effect.
author: batch-SciML-A prototype agent
